lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular spots arranged in vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The spots show a regular horizontal spacing of approximately two spot-diameters in the mid-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of spots, most notably between the fifth gill slit and the anterior edge of the pectoral fin base.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single dominant horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with higher intensity on the dorsal side and a localized shadow-cast on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the pectoral fin displays a high-density distribution of small, uniform, high-luminance circular spots that are significantly smaller in diameter than the spots on the lateral flank.
